method: GitHub code-search extraction of NPC !pos coordinates plus zone NPC-script directory counts. Coordinate samples are not exhaustive retail populations and are not treated as official Square Enix map geometry.

cross_city_readback.interpretation: Core inhabited streets commonly support roughly 6-10 coordinate-units between nearby NPC anchors, while wider/quiet areas can exceed 17-23. Windurst Waters demonstrates that low-density spacious districts can coexist with clustered social nodes.

caveats: LandSandBoat is an emulator/reference implementation, not leaked retail server code.
NPC coordinates may originate from retail captures/community verification but must retain emulator-reference provenance here.
Observed coordinate samples are incomplete because only files surfaced by code search with !pos comments are counted.
No FF11 protected map/model/texture/audio asset body is copied into DOLZORE.
